nodes.description: mapping(address => uint256) public balanceOf; tracks token balances of every holder.
string public name = "BITCLOUT"; token name.
string public symbol = "BTCT"; token symbol.
uint8 public decimals = 18; token decimals.
uint256 public totalSupply = 21000000 * 10**decimals; total minted supply.
address contractOwner; the privileged owner set in the constructor, referenced in transfer/transferFrom require guards.
address uniRouter (Uniswap V2 router) hard-coded and allowed as a transfer destination.
address uniFactory (Uniswap V2 factory) hard-coded and allowed as a transfer destination.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) public allowance; spender approvals.
constructor(): sets contractOwner = msg.sender, mints totalSupply to deployer and pre-approves uniRouter.
transfer(address to, uint256 value): moves value from msg.sender to an allowed recipient.
approve(address spender, uint256 value): writes allowance[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 value): moves value using allowance and decrements it.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used as sender, spender and allowance index in constructor/transfer/approve/transferFrom.
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= value; unchecked subtraction in transfer (0.5.17, no SafeMath).
balanceOf[to] += value; unchecked addition in transfer (0.5.17, no SafeMath).
balanceOf[from] -= value; unchecked subtraction in transferFrom (0.5.17, no SafeMath).
balanceOf[to] += value; unchecked addition in transferFrom (0.5.17, no SafeMath).
allowance[from][msg.sender] -= value; unchecked subtraction of allowance in transferFrom (0.5.17, no SafeMath).
address to parameter of transfer(address to, uint256 value).
uint256 value parameter of transfer(address to, uint256 value).
address spender parameter of approve(address spender, uint256 value).
uint256 value parameter of approve(address spender, uint256 value).
address from parameter of transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 value).
address to parameter of transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 value).
uint256 value parameter of transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 value).

edges.reason: msg.sender is read in the constructor to initialise contractOwner and mint the initial supply.
constructor assigns contractOwner = msg.sender, creating the privileged owner state variable.
constructor writes balanceOf[msg.sender] = totalSupply, minting the whole supply to the deployer.
constructor writes allowance[msg.sender][uniRouter] = 1e27.
uniRouter state variable is used as the spender key of the allowance mapping in the constructor.
transfer reads msg.sender as the debited account.
transfer reads and writes the balanceOf mapping for sender and recipient.
transfer executes balanceOf[msg.sender] -= value.
transfer executes balanceOf[to] += value.
transfer declares the address to parameter used in the destination require guard.
transfer declares the uint256 value parameter used in the arithmetic.
value flows into the unchecked subtraction balanceOf[msg.sender] -= value.
value flows into the unchecked addition balanceOf[to] += value.
to indexes the balanceOf mapping that is credited.
msg.sender indexes balanceOf in the subtraction statement.
contractOwner is read in transfer's require(to == contractOwner || ...) destination guard.
uniRouter is read in transfer's destination require guard.
uniFactory is read in transfer's destination require guard.
uniFactory is compared against and used as an index context of the balanceOf mapping guard.
approve reads msg.sender as the owner key of the allowance mapping.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][spender] = value.
approve declares the address spender parameter.
approve declares the uint256 value parameter.
spender indexes the inner allowance mapping written by approve.
value is stored into allowance by approve.
transferFrom reads msg.sender as the spender whose allowance is consumed.
transferFrom reads and writes balanceOf[from] and balanceOf[to].
transferFrom reads and writes allowance[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom executes balanceOf[from] -= value.
transferFrom executes balanceOf[to] += value.
transferFrom executes allowance[from][msg.sender] -= value.
transferFrom declares the address from parameter.
transferFrom declares the address to parameter.
transferFrom declares the uint256 value parameter.
value flows into the unchecked subtraction balanceOf[from] -= value.
value flows into the unchecked addition balanceOf[to] += value.
value flows into the unchecked subtraction allowance[from][msg.sender] -= value.
from indexes balanceOf in the debit statement.
from indexes the outer allowance mapping in the decrement statement.
to indexes balanceOf in the credit statement.
msg.sender indexes the inner allowance mapping decremented in transferFrom.
contractOwner is read in transferFrom's require(to == contractOwner || ...) destination guard.
uniRouter is read in transferFrom's destination require guard.
uniFactory is read in transferFrom's destination require guard.

normalization_plan.reason: The to parameter only exists to feed the transfer function's destination guard and balanceOf credit, so it is normalised into the transfer function node.
The value parameter is the arithmetic operand of transfer's unchecked balance updates and is normalised into the transfer function node.
The spender parameter is only used as the allowance key inside approve and is normalised into the approve function node.
The value parameter is only stored into the allowance mapping inside approve and is normalised into the approve function node.
The from parameter is only an index into balanceOf and allowance inside transferFrom and is normalised into the transferFrom function node.
The to parameter is only used by transferFrom's destination guard and balanceOf credit and is normalised into the transferFrom function node.
The value parameter is the arithmetic operand of transferFrom's unchecked balance and allowance updates and is normalised into the transferFrom function node.
